ai.seo_question: What is the condition for true spiritual understanding in Surah Al-A'la?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the intrinsic link between *taqwa* (God-consciousness) and *dhikr* (remembrance), suggesting that spiritual receptivity is a prerequisite for divine guidance. Scholars note that this conditionality underscores the active role of the believer in cultivating piety to unlock deeper understanding of the Quran. It serves as a reminder that mere recitation is insufficient without the internal state of reverence.
